title: 4 Quick Color Refreshes for Holiday Hosting
summary: Holiday season is almost here! Get guest-ready in an instant with these easy updates that elevate any space.
body_markdown:
The holiday season has a way of putting every room in your home on display. You don’t, however, need a major renovation to create a welcoming, polished look for guests. A few thoughtful Thanksgiving painting ideas can refresh hardworking spaces, add personality and help your home feel ready for every gathering on the books.


Photo courtesy of *@jg_propertysolutions*
Featured Color:[Iron Ore SW 7069](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7069-iron-ore?msockid=18c17b1627e860d61aa56c5d26b36102)


## **Make the Dining Room the Center of Attention**


The dining room naturally becomes a gathering place during the holidays, making it the perfect space for an eye-catching accent wall. A deep-charcoal focal wall paired with neutrals and white wainscoting adds richness and dimension without requiring a full-room makeover.[Iron Ore](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7069-iron-ore?msockid=18c17b1627e860d61aa56c5d26b36102) helps anchor the space, drawing attention to the table and creating a warm, intimate atmosphere. It’s a quick refresh that delivers major impact when guests arrive.


Photo Courtesty of *[@michellemilowe](https://www.instagram.com/p/CWj8CGPNap5/)*
Featured Colors: *[Accessible Beige SW 7036](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7036-accessible-beige)* (wainscoting);[Alabaster SW 7008](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/white-paint-colors/SW7008-alabaster) (walls); *[Tricorn Black SW 6258](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW6258-tricorn-black)* (nightstand)


## **Refresh a Guest Bedroom with Painted Wainscoting**


When it comes to creating an inviting guest bedroom, subtle color can go a long way. Instead of repainting the entire room, focus on the wainscoting with a soft, light neutral like[Accessible Beige](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW7036-accessible-beige) that subtly grounds the space while still feeling bright and relaxing. Paired with[Alabaster](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/white-paint-colors/SW7008-alabaster) walls, the contrast creates a clean, tailored look that feels both timeless and welcoming. It’s a simple update that helps guests feel instantly comfortable and cared for.


Photo courtesy of *[@smc.living](https://www.instagram.com/p/CXOgHw-l14t/)*
Featured Color:[Evergreen Fog SW 9130](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW9130-evergreen-fog)


## **Add a Dose of Character to a Hallway or Nook**


Pass-through spaces are easy to overlook, but they’re full of design potential. Painting the wainscoting a soft-green hue is an easy way to add color and personality without overwhelming the space. Against warm neutral walls,[Evergreen Fog](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/green-paint-colors/SW9130-evergreen-fog) creates a fresh, collected feel that transitions beautifully from room to room. The result is a small but memorable detail that makes your home feel thoughtfully finished.


Photo courtesy of *@threeluxenine*
Featured Color:[Black Magic SW 6991](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW6991-black-magic)


## **Create a Moody Moment in a Half Bath**


If there’s one room where you can take a risk with color, it’s the half bath. Painting the wall above white wainscoting in a rich, moody shade instantly elevates the space and creates a dramatic, formal feel. The crisp-white lower portion keeps the room feeling balanced, while[Black Magic](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/neutral-paint-colors/SW6991-black-magic) adds sophistication and depth. Though guests may only spend a few minutes here, it’s sure to leave a lasting impression.


## **Get Started with Color Samples**


Not sure which shade is right for your space? Color samples make it easy to find confidence before committing. Test these shades in your home with[FREE color chips](https://samples.sherwin-williams.com/?colors=SW7069-S,SW7036-S,SW7008-S,SW9130-S,SW6991-S) to see how they work with your lighting and décor and find the perfect fit for your holiday refresh. With just a little color and a free weekend, you can create a home that feels updated and inviting.
